verdict.rationale: Databricks metric views are a first-party semantic layer. You define a metric once (e.g. revenue divided by distinct customers), users group by any available field, and the query engine generates the correct computation. Those metrics are reused across queries and dashboards and can be queried from Power BI, Tableau and Sigma, and the feature sits under Unity Catalog, which enforces access control. missing for 10: explicit documentation of declaring joins in the model, explicit evidence that Genie or other AI tools answer against metric views, independent or hands-on corroboration.
